_meta.comment: Scripted scenario inputs for the touch-cascade golden harness (Phase C unit C0). Times are seconds from the scenario start on the fake clock; a touch report is built from each consecutive step's 'blocks'. Statuses: down=0xC0, move=0x80, up=0x20. Pen steps feed parse_pen_packet only (the palm-rejection gate), interleaved like the Pen and Touch reader threads share one TabletState. Slot ids start at 1: slot 0 decodes as an empty block.
_meta.format: steps: [{t, kind: touch|pen, blocks: [[slot, status, x, y]...], status: in|tip_down|out}]
_meta.config: per-scenario flips: {toggles: {...}, mapping: {...}} over the shipped DriverConfig defaults; motion thresholds stay default on purpose (see golden_harness.make_config).

scenarios.name: 1f_drag
scenarios.desc: One finger slides right in 24-unit packets over eleven packets, then lifts: cursor-move stream through the fractional cursor accumulator (the carry finally emits 16 on the last packet), and the release skips the tap lane because drift exceeded tap_max_movement.

scenarios.name: 1f_tap_single
scenarios.desc: Quick single-finger tap inside max_tap_duration with zero drift: mapped 1f_tap action (left_click pair).

scenarios.name: 1f_double_tap_drag_left_hold_release
scenarios.desc: Tap, second touch inside double_tap_timeout: 1f_double_tap fires left_hold on the second touch-down packet; the lift fires left_hold_release.
scenarios.note: Quirks documented by the golden: the double-tap fires on the second touch-DOWN packet (zero drift, window still open); dispatch latches active_gesture but handle_left_hold clears it again, so the cursor lane re-opens and moves keep flowing while the button is held; the is_left_held guard on the double-tap condition is what keeps a second left_hold dispatch away.

scenarios.name: 1f_double_tap_static_drag_holds
scenarios.desc: Double-tap whose second touch keeps drift under tap_max_movement for three packets inside the window: one left_hold only, then cursor moves keep flowing while the button stays held.
scenarios.note: Contract-lock golden: the is_left_held guard on the double-tap condition (not active_gesture, which handle_left_hold re-clears) blocks the per-packet re-dispatch that the open drift condition would otherwise allow -- C2 must keep that guard.

scenarios.name: 1f_tap_outside_double_window
scenarios.desc: Two taps 0.4 s apart, double_tap_timeout is 0.25 s: two independent left_click pairs, no left_hold, drag_candidate stays off.

scenarios.name: 1f_press_hold_left_drag
scenarios.desc: Static single-finger hold crossing press_hold_duration: 1f_press fires left_hold once; the lift fires left_hold_release.

scenarios.name: 2f_scroll_up
scenarios.desc: Two fingers translate up 10 units per packet: scroll latches once the centroid travel crosses scroll_activation_threshold, then one wheel event per packet; the lift skips the tap lane (scroll_active).

scenarios.name: 2f_scroll_down
scenarios.desc: Two fingers translate down 10 units per packet: same latch, wheel events carry the opposite sign.

scenarios.name: 2f_scroll_left
scenarios.desc: Two fingers translate left 10 units per packet: horizontal wheel (HWHEEL) events.
scenarios.note: Quirk documented by the golden: the horizontal step uses NEGATED scroll_sensitivity_x (vertical does not negate), so a leftward glide emits positive HWHEEL deltas -- the shipped x/y asymmetry.

scenarios.name: 2f_scroll_right
scenarios.desc: Two fingers translate right 10 units per packet: horizontal wheel events on the same negated-x lane (see 2f_scroll_left), so a rightward glide emits negative HWHEEL deltas.

scenarios.name: 2f_pinch_out
scenarios.desc: Two fingers each move 20 units outward per packet (the spread metric grows 20: it is the mean distance to the centroid): crossing pinch_activation_threshold presses ctrl once and emits on the activation packet, then one wheel event per packet; the full lift fires the ctrl release leg.

scenarios.name: 2f_pinch_toggle_off_ctrl_still_presses
scenarios.desc: Same 2f spread as 2f_pinch_out with the 2f_pinch feature toggle flipped off.
scenarios.note: Quirk documented by the golden: pinch ACTIVATION (the ctrl key-down, and the ctrl key-up on the release leg) is NOT gated by the 2f_pinch toggle -- only the wheel emission inside the active branch is. The stream shows ctrl down/up with zero wheel events.

scenarios.name: 2f_pinch_in
scenarios.desc: Two fingers pinch together 40 units per packet: ctrl latch plus negative wheel events every packet, same activation-packet emission.

scenarios.name: 2f_to_1f_scroll_continuation
scenarios.desc: Active 2f scroll, then one finger lifts: 2f_scroll is in the continuation list, so the remaining finger restarts 1f cursor tracking and keeps moving the cursor after the lift.

scenarios.name: 2f_tap_default_disabled
scenarios.desc: Quick two-finger tap with the shipped defaults: 2f_tap feature toggle is False out of the box, so the stream is empty.
scenarios.note: Documents the shipped default (2f_tap off), not a bug: the tap lane runs but dispatch_gesture_event refuses while the toggle is off.

scenarios.name: 2f_tap_enabled_right_click
scenarios.desc: Same two-finger tap with the 2f_tap toggle flipped on: mapped right_click pair fires on the release report.

scenarios.name: 2f_press_hold
scenarios.desc: Two static fingers crossing press_hold_duration: 2f_press fires once (dispatch latches active_gesture), mapped right_click pair.

scenarios.name: 2f_pinch_to_3f_release_ctrl
scenarios.desc: Active 2f pinch (ctrl held; each packet moves both fingers 20 units outward), a third finger lands: the ctrl release leg fires at the report head because num_active left 2, and the 3f transition clears the pinch state; the release itself adds nothing.

scenarios.name: 3f_tap
scenarios.desc: Quick three-finger tap: mapped 3f_tap action (middle_click pair).

scenarios.name: 3f_swipe_right_in_cap
scenarios.desc: Three fingers swipe right 80 units per packet inside the session-duration cap: 3f_swipe_right fires once (latched), mapped window_right (lwin+right tap).

scenarios.name: 3f_swipe_left
scenarios.desc: Three fingers swipe left: 3f_swipe_left fires once, mapped window_left (lwin+left tap).

scenarios.name: 3f_pinch_in_discrete_undo
scenarios.desc: Three fingers contract toward the centroid by 25 percent in one packet: spread change crosses pinch_discrete_threshold, 3f_pinch_in fires once, mapped undo (ctrl+z tap).

scenarios.name: session_cap_blocks_3f_swipe
scenarios.desc: Session starts as a 1f touch; two more fingers land and swipe right only after max_gesture_touch_session_duration passed: the 3f recognition lane stays shut, the late release also skips the tap lane (session over max_tap_duration). Control counterpart of 3f_swipe_right_in_cap.

scenarios.name: 4f_swipe_right_next
scenarios.desc: Four fingers swipe right 70 units per packet: 4f_swipe_right fires once, mapped next (alt+right tap).

scenarios.name: 5f_alt_tab_flow
scenarios.desc: Five fingers land: 5f_alt_tab initiates (ctrl+alt+tab tap); twelve 70-unit step packets cross alt_tab_step_threshold twice through the f5_counter rate limiter; the full lift commits (enter tap).

scenarios.name: pen_gate_touch_ignored
scenarios.desc: Pen enters proximity and lands on the tablet mid-session: 1f tap attempts and a 2f pinch attempt emit NOTHING while the gate is closed; after the pen leaves, the next clean 1f tap works again.

scenarios.name: pen_touch_interleave_mid_scroll
scenarios.desc: 2f scroll runs, pen enters proximity mid-gesture and leaves again: the gated packets emit nothing while the contacts keep moving, and the first post-pen packet compares against the STALE pre-pen centroid.
scenarios.note: Quirk documented by the golden: last_2finger_centroid is not re-based across the pen gap, so the first post-pen wheel event carries the whole skipped travel; pen-leave also rewrites session_start_time/start_time.

scenarios.name: 3f_swipe_up
scenarios.desc: Three fingers swipe up 70 units in one packet: the y-dominance branch latches 3f_swipe_up (shipped default ON), mapped window_up (lwin+up tap).

scenarios.name: 3f_swipe_down
scenarios.desc: Three fingers swipe down 70 units in one packet: y-dominance branch, 3f_swipe_down (default ON), mapped window_down (lwin+down tap).

scenarios.name: 4f_swipe_down_show_desktop
scenarios.desc: Four fingers swipe down 70 units in one packet: 4f_swipe_down (default ON), mapped show_desktop (lwin+d tap).

scenarios.name: 3f_pinch_out_discrete_redo
scenarios.desc: Three fingers expand away from the centroid by 20+ units in one packet: the positive-sign discrete branch latches 3f_pinch_out (default ON), mapped redo (ctrl+y tap) -- the sign counterpart of 3f_pinch_in_discrete_undo.

scenarios.name: 4f_tap_task_view
scenarios.desc: Quick four-finger tap: the peak==4 tap branch (4f_tap shipped ON), mapped task_view (lwin+tab tap).
